'''Mawler''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Mawler}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Rip and Tear
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (14;{{Asc2|9|16}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Roar
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 3 {{BD2|Vulnerable}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Vulnerable
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Claw
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (4;{{Asc2|9|5}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always opens with {{Int2|Mawler|Claw}}.

After that, each turn it randomly picks one of three moves with equal chance: {{Int2|Mawler|Rip and Tear}}, {{Int2|Mawler|Roar}}, or {{Int2|Mawler|Claw}}. It cannot use the same move twice in a row, and {{Int2|Mawler|Roar}} can only be used once per fight.

== Trivia ==

* The Mawler's name and appearance reference [[The Maw]], an enemy from the original Slay the Spire.
